soldier: The soldier has the head capsule amber-brown, mandibles blackish brown, labrum, antennae and eye spots brown, pronotum yellowish brown, abdomen pale yellowish brown, the posterior half of the tenth abdominal tergite more strongly sclerotised and darker, legs brown or slightly paler than the head capsule. Head capsule elongate-cylindrical, the sides parallel, the posterolateral angles broadly rounded; in profile the dorsolateral frontal angle slightly raised, the frontal slope about 45 degrees, the frontal surface a shallow V-shaped depression with several shallow longitudinal striae in the middle, the Y-shaped suture faint, the compound eyes visible, their distance to the antennal socket less than the transverse diameter of the eye. Labrum slightly short-circular with a flat tip; mandibles short and stout with rather curved tips, the left mandible shorter than half the head capsule. Antennae with 12 segments. The postmentum six to seven times as long as the waist, the broad region in the anterior third and trapezoidal, the sides of the anterior part slightly concave inwards, depressed behind the anterior margin and with several transverse striae; the waist region in the posterior third, the posterior margin arcuately convex. The pronotum narrower than the head, the anterior margin shallowly concave with a slight median notch, the lateral margins sloping gently backwards, the middle of the posterior margin slightly concave forwards, the median line pale and depressed.
